USER REQUEST:
Write a polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Independent Set. problems.py defines both problems: SOURCE is Vertex Cover and TARGET is Independent Set. The SOURCE and TARGET class docstrings give the exact instance formats, yes-conditions and edge cases.

PROBLEM DEFINITIONS (the SOURCE and TARGET docstrings from problems.py, complete as given here):

SOURCE = VertexCover
Vertex Cover.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has a vertex cover of AT MOST k vertices: a set of
vertices that includes at least one endpoint of every edge.

Edge cases: k < 0 is always no. A graph with no edges is yes for every
k >= 0 (the empty set covers it). k >= n is yes, since all vertices cover
every edge.

TARGET = IndependentSet
Independent Set.

Instance: {"n": n, "edges": [[u, v], ...], "k": k}
  * Vertices are 0..n-1. Edges are undirected pairs [u, v] with u != v;
    [u, v] and [v, u] are the same edge and may not both appear.
  * k is any integer.

Yes iff the graph has an independent set of AT LEAST k vertices: k
vertices with no edge between any two of them.

Edge cases: k <= 0 is always yes. k > n is always no. With no edges,
every set of vertices is independent.

INPUT FILES: ["problems.py"]
WORKING DIRECTORY: /tmp/reduction-ubtv7bv9

The answer to the returned instance must be yes exactly when the answer to the input instance is yes, and reduce must run in polynomial time. Do not call the brute-force solvers inside reduce.

"""Polynomial-time reduction from Vertex Cover to Independent Set.

Given a Vertex Cover instance (G, k), produce the Independent Set instance
(G, n - k).  A set C is a vertex cover of G if and only if V \\ C is an
independent set of G.  Hence G has a vertex cover of size at most k exactly
when G has an independent set of size at least n - k.

The reduction leaves n and edges unchanged and runs in O(n + m) time.
"""


def reduce(instance):
    """Reduce a Vertex Cover instance to an Independent Set instance."""
    n = instance["n"]
    edges = instance["edges"]
    k = instance["k"]

    # Copy the edge list so the returned instance does not alias the input.
    target_edges = [[u, v] for (u, v) in edges]

    return {"n": n, "edges": target_edges, "k": n - k}
EOF
